/*
 * Design tokens after PyCharm 2026.1 "Islands". :root holds Islands Dark,
 * [data-theme="light"] Islands Light (the default theme), [data-theme="dark-hc"]
 * the high-contrast dark variant. Colours come from ManyIslandsDark/Light.theme.json
 * (+ expUI parents) and the Islands Dark / Light editor schemes; metrics are the
 * theme JSON values at 100% zoom. Components use only these variables.
 */
/*
 * Editor font weights (Settings › Editor › Font › Typography Settings; set on
 * the root at runtime). Outside `:root` so scheme tokens such as
 * `--matched-brace-weight` keep referring to them instead of a resolved value.
 */
html {
  --fw-code: 400;
  --fw-code-bold: 700;
}
:root {
  /* Spacing scale on a 4px grid: --space-N = N * 4px. Used for gap. */
  --space-0-5: 2px;
  --space-1: 4px;
  --space-1-5: 6px;
  --space-2: 8px;
  --space-3: 12px;
  --space-4: 16px;
  --agent-conversation-width: 900px;
  --splash-logo-size: 56px;
  --splash-bar-width: 120px;
  --splash-bar-height: 2px;
  --splash-gap: 14px;
  --splash-offset: 38px;
  --splash-progress-duration: 4s;
  --splash-progress-easing: cubic-bezier(0.1, 0.7, 0.3, 1);
  /* surfaces */
  --bg-app: #191a1c;
  --bg-elev: #212326;
  --bg-popup: #26282c;
  --bg-floating-toolbar: #33353b;
  --bg-hover: #2e2f30;
  --bg-selected: #2a4371;
  --bg-selected-strong: #2e4d89;
  --bg-current-line: #1f2024;
  --bg-debug-line: #2a5091;
  --bg-breakpoint-line: #3b2425;
  --bg-backdrop: #26282c;
  --bg-input: #191a1c;

  /* lines */
  --border: #26282c;
  --border-popup: #33353b;
  --border-strong: #40434a;
  --border-window: #40434a;
  --control-off: #5f6269;

  /* text */
  --fg-strong: #dfe1e5;
  --fg-emphasis: #d1d3d9;
  --fg: #d1d3d9;
  --fg-secondary: #9fa2a8;
  --fg-muted: #8c8f95;
  --fg-subtle: #73767c;
  --fg-faint: #5f6269;
  --fg-gutter: #4b5059;
  --fg-icon: #ced0d6;

  /* accent (PyCharm brand blue; the appearance setting can override it) */
  --accent: #3871e1;
  --link: #71a1fe;
  --link-hover: #92b7ff;

  /* charts (IDEA's first series colour) */
  --chart-series: #e07a7c;

  /* status */
  --danger: #f57e84;
  --warning: #d59637;
  --success: #6db083;
  /* Database tree: the dot on a connected data source (IDEA paints it vivid green with a thin ring). */
  --db-connected: #2fe02f;
  --db-connected-ring: #1d6b1d;
  --info: #548af7;

  /* vcs (FILESTATUS_* / gutter *_LINES_COLOR) */
  --vcs-modified: #70aeff;
  --vcs-added: #73bd79;
  --vcs-deleted: #6f737a;
  --vcs-untracked: #e88f89;
  --vcs-ignored: #d69a6b;
  --vcs-conflict: #de6a66;
  --gutter-modified: #375fad;
  --gutter-added: #549159;
  --gutter-deleted: #868a91;
  /* diff viewer change types (IDEA DIFF_MODIFIED / INSERTED / DELETED) */
  --diff-modified: #385570;
  --diff-inserted: #294436;
  --diff-deleted: #484a4a;
  /* their error stripe marks (ERROR_STRIPE_COLOR of the same keys and DIFF_CONFLICT) */
  --diff-modified-stripe: #43698d;
  --diff-inserted-stripe: #447152;
  --diff-deleted-stripe: #656e76;
  --diff-conflict-stripe: #8f5247;

  /* coverage (IDEA LINE_FULL / PARTIAL / NONE_COVERAGE), following the theme's status colours */
  --coverage-covered: var(--gutter-added);
  --coverage-partial: var(--warning);
  --coverage-uncovered: var(--danger);
  /* profiler flame graph: warm, low-contrast frames; search matches in the accent */
  --flame-1: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warning) 45%, var(--bg-elev));
  --flame-2: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warning) 32%, var(--bg-elev));
  --flame-3: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 36%, var(--bg-elev));
  --flame-4: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 26%, var(--bg-elev));
  --flame-match: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 60%, var(--bg-elev));
  --flame-type: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, var(--bg-elev));
  --flame-fg: var(--fg-strong);

  /* syntax (Islands Dark scheme) */
  --syn-keyword: #cf8e6d;
  --syn-string: #6aab73;
  --syn-type: #bcbec4;
  --syn-function: #56a8f5;
  --syn-function-call: #bcbec4;
  --syn-shell-command: #c57633;
  --syn-comment: #7a7e85;
  --syn-comment-style: normal;
  --syn-doc-comment: #5f826b;
  --syn-doc-comment-tag: #67a37c;
  --syn-doc-comment-tag-effect: none;
  --syn-doc-comment-tag-value: #abadb3;
  --syn-doc-markup: #68a67e;
  --syn-doc-markup-bg: transparent;
  --syn-docstring: #5f826b;
  --syn-annotation: #b3ae60;
  --syn-decorator: #b3ae60;
  --syn-number: #2aacb8;
  --syn-punct: #bcbec4;
  --syn-variable: #bcbec4;
  --syn-global: var(--syn-variable);
  --syn-namespace: var(--fg-editor);
  --syn-param: #bcbec4;
  --syn-property: #c77dbb;
  --syn-constant: #c77dbb;
  --syn-python-local-variable: var(--syn-variable);
  --syn-python-global-variable: var(--syn-global);
  --syn-python-instance-attribute: var(--syn-variable);
  --syn-python-class-attribute: var(--syn-property);
  --syn-python-constant: var(--syn-constant);

  --syn-python-parentheses: var(--syn-punct);

  --syn-python-braces: var(--syn-punct);
  --syn-python-nested-function: var(--syn-function);
  --syn-python-method-call: var(--syn-function-call);

  --syn-python-format: var(--syn-escape);
  --syn-python-builtin: var(--syn-builtin);
  --syn-python-predefined-definition: var(--syn-predefined);
  --syn-python-predefined-usage: var(--syn-predefined);
  --syn-python-fstring: #a5c261;
